title: The Ultimate Trial Begins
next_chapter_hook: Just as the boundary between the third and fourth pages of the Tianji Record began to blur, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power breaking free from its chains—and he had to make a choice in that instant, bearing the ultimate backlash of fate.

text.content: That will was no longer cold and distant as before; what descended now was a hunger capable of devouring everything. Chen Ji felt his consciousness gripped by an invisible giant hand, the surrounding scenes shattering like broken glass—altar, profound ice, the remnants of bloodline resonance—everything crushed into dust beneath that will's pressure. What replaced it was an endless dark void.

He had thought he had witnessed the pressure of Heavenly Dao, but the power before him now was a hundred times more formidable! That was a truly transcendent existence beyond mortal comprehension, as if an invisible pair of eyes was piercing through the void, staring intently at him, determined to see through all his secrets. "Interesting." The voice rang out again, no longer the echo from the altar before, but exploding directly within his Mental Sea. "Heir of the fragment, a mere pawn on the chessboard, yet you dare peer at my true form."

Before the words finished, the dark void began to twist violently. A faint light appeared, then expanded like a star, transforming into a majestic and boundless great gate. The gate's doors were covered with patterns Chen Ji had never seen before—patterns that seemed alive, writhing and emitting a chilling aura. Beneath this great gate, Chen Ji's form appeared so insignificant, like an ant gazing up at the heavens.

dialogue.content: "Since you've made it here, it means you've earned the qualification to participate in the final trial." The voice came from behind the great gate, carrying an indescribable arrogance and playfulness. "A mere servant of the Tianqing Sect, heir to the Tianji Record fragment—do you know where this fragment comes from?" Chen Ji did not answer. He knew that before such an existence, any lie was meaningless. Indeed, the voice continued on its own: "It is a seed I sowed countless ages ago."

text.content: Seed? Chen Ji's heart trembled violently. Mister Mo had told him that the Tianji Record was a supreme treasure left by ancient prophets, an unmatched technique for glimpsing heavenly secrets and foretelling the future. But this voice claimed it was a "sowed seed"? Could it be that from the very beginning, the inheritance of the Tianji Record had fallen into some kind of scheme?

The great gate crashed open, an ancient and desolate aura rushing forth. Chen Ji was swept up by an irresistible force and drifted through the gate. The world beyond surprised him—it was not some immortal paradise, but a barren ruin. Countless bleached bones lay scattered among the ruins and broken walls, some frozen in the midst of struggle, others turned to dust. This was the final resting place of all who had participated in the final trial over countless years.

dialogue.content: "This is the stage I have prepared for you so-called 'Chosen Ones.'" The voice of the Heavenly Dao's Eye rang out once more, and this time, Chen Ji finally saw its true form—a being impossible to describe in words, without shape or boundary, only a massive vertical pupil floating above the ruins, its depths seeming to contain the operating laws of the entire universe. "The content of the final trial is simple: face your deepest fear, and then—" That vertical pupil contracted sharply, "—choose."

text.content: "Choose?" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the ruins. The vertical pupil seemed to laugh: "Abandon resistance, accept the fated chains I bestow upon you, become a true heir of the Tianji Record; or—" Its voice turned ice-cold, "—break the trial's rules by force, cast off the chains, but the price is, everything you care about will be erased before your eyes."

Before the words finished, the scene before Chen Ji transformed once more. The ruins vanished, replaced by a familiar sight—the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, familiar stone steps, familiar halls, familiar clouds and mist. However, at this moment, all of it was shrouded in an ominous crimson light.

"Ji-ge!" A familiar voice rang out behind him. Chen Ji whirled around to see Chen Nian—his sister he had searched for so many years, now standing there perfectly intact, her face bearing a long-missed smile. But the next moment, that smile froze. An invisible force descended from the heavens, piercing directly through Chen Nian's body.

Blood splattered. Chen Nian's form slowly collapsed before Chen Ji's eyes, those eyes still wide open, filled with confusion and fear. "No—!" Chen Ji screamed as he rushed forward, only to find he could not touch Chen Nian at all. That figure was like a phantom, passing through his hands. And the voice of the Heavenly Dao's Eye rang in his ears: "This is the price for choosing to break through by force. The person you care about most will be erased one by one before your eyes."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye presents the final choice. How will you decide?

choices.text: Abandon resistance, accept the fated chains
choices.description: Submit to Heavenly Dao's arrangement, transform the Tianji Record into a true inheritance, gain complete Heavenly Secrets foresight ability, but forever become a chess piece of Heavenly Dao's will.
choices.visible_cost: Lose free will, become a Heavenly Dao puppet
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record completely unlocked, foresight ability reaches its peak
choices.risk_hint: Seemingly safe, but actually heading for eternal doom

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He watched Chen Nian's form slowly dissipate before his eyes, those死不瞑目的 eyes, his heart torn apart. Abandoning resistance might be the wisest choice. After all, as long as there's life, there's always a chance for a comeback.

However, just as he was about to speak, another figure appeared—Su Qingyao. She held a sword, her expression cold and resolute, yet when her eyes met Chen Ji's, a complex light flickered within them. "Chen Ji, you cannot agree to it!" Her voice pierced through the illusion, striking his very soul. "Once you accept the chains, there will be no turning back!"

choices.text: Break through by force, fight to the bitter end
choices.description: Refuse Heavenly Dao's arrangement, forcefully break the trial's rules, ignite all bloodline potential, confront Heavenly Dao's will directly.
choices.visible_cost: Those you care about will be erased one by one
choices.visible_reward: Shatter the fated chains, Tianji Record breaks through to the fourth level
choices.risk_hint: The price is brutal, but you can maintain your true self

text.content: A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He stared at that massive pupil floating in the void, and his lips actually curved into a cold smile. "You think this illusion can scare me?" His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Chen Ji crawled out from mountains of corpses and rivers of blood—what haven't I seen? Trying to threaten me with my sister's death? You've miscalculated!"

The vertical pupil contracted sharply, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's reaction. And at this moment, Chen Ji felt the bloodline power within him churning like boiling magma. The Tianji Record fragment began to operate on its own, emitting dazzling golden light. At the same time, a remnant soul emerged from the fragment—it was Mister Mo. "Young master, this old one has waited for this moment for a very long time." Mister Mo's voice rang in Chen Ji's ear. "Since you've made your choice—break through!"

The illusion transformed once more. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Mister Mo—all those connected to Chen Ji appeared in this crimson void. Their forms wavered, on the verge of being erased at any moment. And the voice of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was mercilessly cold: "Continue resisting, and their deaths become real. Each time you resist, I will erase one person you care about."

Chen Ji's hands trembled slightly. Those were his hands hidden in his sleeves, steady as rock before any enemy, yet now they couldn't stop shaking. He watched Su Qingyao's form, watched that cold and beautiful face gradually contort, as if enduring tremendous agony. He knew this was an illusion, a tool Heavenly Dao used to shatter his will. But—that was Su Qingyao!

"Chen Ji." Su Qingyao's voice pierced through the illusion, no longer her usual coldness, but carrying an unprecedented gentleness. "Don't worry about us. Don't compromise because of us. You've never been alone; we'll always be by your side." Her form began to fade, just like Chen Nian's dissolution earlier. Ye Qing's voice followed: "Trash, don't let this old lady down!"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's forms are fading. How will you decide?

choices.text: Abandon them, focus on breaking through
choices.description: Treat their forms as illusions, focus on bloodline breakthrough, remain unmoved.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly closed his eyes, sealing out all those voices and forms. His consciousness sank deep into his Mental Sea, confronting the binding force coiled at the core of the Tianji Record. "You want me to be a chess piece?" His voice was ice-cold. "Chen Ji, in this lifetime, only plays the role of chess player!"

choices.description: Use your Heavenly Fate and bloodline power to attempt sharing their pain, delaying their dissolution.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the bond with them, gain stronger fighting will
choices.risk_hint: Massive Heavenly Fate consumption may be fatal

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, his gaze bloodshot. He stepped forward, his form transforming into a golden stream of light, charging directly toward the core of that crimson void. He didn't care about the illusion, didn't care about the price—he only knew that he absolutely could not watch them dissipate! "If we die, we die together!" His roar shook the void.

At this moment, the bloodline power within Chen Ji finally broke through the critical point. Eighty percent—he felt that bottleneck, that barrier that had blocked countless geniuses, now collapsing under the impetus of despair and rage. Golden light erupted from within him, illuminating the entire ruins, even forcing that massive pupil floating in the void to retreat several paces.

Meanwhile, the Tianji Record fragment began to tremble violently. Chen Ji felt the scroll within his Mental Sea undergoing some incomprehensible change—the boundary between the third and fourth pages beginning to blur, as if some sealed power was awakening. Mister Mo's remnant soul let out a cry of alarm: "This is...the雏形 of the fourth level! Young master, you've broken through at this moment!"

The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice fluctuated for the first time: "Impossible! A mere mortal, breaking through to the fourth level under the backlash of the chains?" But Chen Ji had no time to heed its astonishment. He felt his body undergoing some kind of transformation, every inch of skin, every strand of bone, every thread of consciousness being reshaped by this power. Heavenly Fate Value burned furiously, yet his consciousness was clearer than ever.

However, the price of breakthrough manifested simultaneously. Black cracks began appearing on Chen Ji's body surface—that was the scar of the chains' backlash. Intense pain surged like a tide, nearly tearing his consciousness apart. But Chen Ji clenched his teeth, forcibly suppressing that agony. His eyes burned with unprecedented light—that was不甘, was rage,更是破釜沉舟的determined。
